entities.name: PMID:25452056
observations: 2015 Addictive Behaviors study: 49 adults recruited at campus drinking venues; BAC ranged from 0.002% to 0.19%.

Adjusted model found BAC negatively predicted money won on the final two Iowa Gambling Task blocks, controlling for demographics, habitual alcohol use (tolerance proxy), drug use, impulsivity/disinhibition, and everyday executive functioning.

entities.name: BAC–IGT winnings association
observations: In naturalistic campus drinking settings, higher BAC negatively predicted IGT money won on the final two blocks after covariate adjustment including trait impulsivity and habitual alcohol use as a proxy for tolerance; n=49.
